## Objetivo
Promover el estado actual de `develop` hacia `release` para preparar el siguiente ciclo de publicación.

## Contexto
- `release` (actual): `7a0859e`
- Delta: `develop` contiene **123 commits** adicionales.

## Qué entra en este pase (highlights)
- **CI/Calidad (PR Gate)**: un workflow merge-blocking unificado con ejecución condicional por rama destino.
  - `develop`: typecheck + lint + prettier + tests con coverage + SonarCloud (quality gate) + Vercel preview/comment.
  - `release`: typecheck + lint + prettier + tests (sin coverage).
  - `main`: lint + prettier.
- **Hardening de GitHub Actions**: acciones pinneadas a SHAs completos + Dependabot (agrupado, semanal, 1 PR abierto).
- **SonarCloud**: integración en CI y refactors en tests para cumplir reglas (asserts explícitos, `.find()` en vez de `.filter()[0]`, simplificación de helpers, etc.).
- **Vercel**: preview deploy + comentario en PR (en PRs a `develop` según la estrategia definida).

## Notas
- El diff es grande (incluye cambios de configuración, workflows y refactors); revisar principalmente:
  - `.github/workflows/*` (estrategia de gates)
  - `.github/dependabot.yml` (updates agrupados)
  - Ajustes en tests para Sonar/Vitest

# 🚀 Experimental: Eleventy Static Site Generator

Prototype implementation of [Eleventy (11ty)](https://www.11ty.dev/) as an alternative to MkDocs for documentation generation. Evaluates feasibility for Korean/English bilingual documentation with modern static site tooling.

## Implementation

### Core Setup
- Eleventy v3.1.2 with Nunjucks templating
- Plugins: syntax highlighting, markdown-it with attributes
- Build pipeline: `docs/` → `_site/` (0.35s for 13 pages)
- npm scripts: `start` (dev server + live reload), `build`, `watch`, `debug`

### UI/UX
- Dark Material Design theme (inline CSS)
- Korean language support: `lang="ko"`, Nanum Gothic font
- Responsive navigation matching existing MkDocs structure
- All 13 markdown files migrated with front matter

### Search
- [Pagefind](https://pagefind.app/) client-side search (no server required)
- 13 pages indexed: 4,717 words
- Bilingual UI translations (Korean + English)
- Instant results with term highlighting

```yaml
---
layout: base.njk
title: Guide - Create Port
---

# Guide: Create Port
Content here...
```

## Visual Results

**Homepage with search**
![Homepage](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fe4e5081-cc3e-489d-a80d-811cf18c8c74)

**Search results (13 matches for "vcpkg")**
![Search](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3c735895-f273-4b0c-99cc-23b4137bbb8f)

**Guide page rendering**
![Guide](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/24633138-a75f-414b-867b-6d87aad3ce7c)

## Comparison

| Metric | MkDocs | Eleventy (this PR) |
|--------|--------|-------------------|
| Build time | ~1s+ | 0.35s |
| Search | Server-side | Client-side |
| Korean search UI | ❌ | ✅ |
| Customization | Theme-constrained | Full control |
| Runtime | Python | Node.js |

## Usage

```bash
npm install          # Install dependencies
npm start            # Dev server @ localhost:8080
npm run build        # Production build + search index
```

## Files Added/Modified

- `.eleventy.js` - Configuration
- `package.json` - Dependencies (eleventy, pagefind, markdown-it)
- `docs/_layouts/base.njk` - Base template with search UI
- `docs/ELEVENTY-README.md` - Setup documentation
- `docs/*.md` - Front matter added (13 files)
- `.gitignore` - Exclude `node_modules/`, `_site/`

## Future Considerations

- Sidebar navigation / TOC
- Image optimization pipeline
- Asset minification
- RSS feeds
- Search analytics

---

**Note:** This is an experimental branch (`copilot/experiment-eleventy-implementation`) for evaluation purposes. Not intended for immediate merge to main.

## Summary

Implements Epic 58: Package & Visitor Management for the Property Management System.

### Features
- **Package Tracking**: Residents can track packages with tracking numbers, carrier info, and status updates
- **Staff Package Management**: Staff can log package arrivals and notify residents
- **Package History**: View package history with filtering by status
- **Visitor Pre-Registration**: Residents can pre-register visitors with temporary access codes
- **Access Code Verification**: Staff can verify visitor access codes at check-in
- **Building Settings**: Configurable package and visitor settings per building

### Backend Changes
- New migration: `00068_create_package_visitor_management.sql` with 4 tables:
  - `packages` - Package records with status workflow
  - `visitors` - Visitor records with access codes
  - `building_package_settings` - Package configuration per building
  - `building_visitor_settings` - Visitor configuration per building
- New repository: `PackageVisitorRepository` with full CRUD operations
- New routes: `/api/v1/packages/*` and `/api/v1/visitors/*`
- Role-based authorization for staff-only operations
- Unique access code generation with collision detection
- Input validation for building settings

### Frontend Changes
- New API client module: `packages/` with types, API functions, and React hooks
- New components: `PackageCard`, `VisitorCard`
- New pages: Package list, Package detail, Visitor list, Visitor detail

### Security
- Role-based authorization checks for staff operations (receive, check-in, check-out)
- Input validation on all building settings
- Unique access code generation with retry logic

## Test Plan
- [ ] Verify package CRUD operations work correctly
- [ ] Test visitor pre-registration flow
- [ ] Verify access code generation is unique
- [ ] Test staff-only endpoints require proper authorization
- [ ] Verify building settings validation

body:
Separates the monolithic database into two: `scrape.db` for raw scraped data, `data.db` for expensive LLM-processed data. Enables copying scrape.db between machines without overwriting processed data.

## Database Structure

**scrape.db** (raw data)
- `jobs` - job postings with titles, URLs, descriptions
- `job_checks` - availability check history

**data.db** (processed data)  
- `job_details` - LLM-extracted structured data
- 50+ lookup tables for normalized fields (skills, locations, etc.)

Cross-database reference via `job_url` string instead of foreign keys.

## Changes

- **New modules**
  - `src/scrape_database.py` - scrape.db schema and session
  - `src/data_database.py` - data.db schema and session  
  - `src/data_repository.py` - repository pattern for processed data

- **Updated scraping operations** → write to scrape.db
  - `src/scrape_jobs_list.py`, `src/scrape_job_details.py`, `src/scrape_job_recheck.py`
  - `src/db_operations.py`, `src/scheduled_scraper*.py`

- **Updated LLM processing** → read from scrape.db, write to data.db
  - `src/structure_data_with_llm.py` now queries both databases independently
  - Identifies unprocessed jobs by checking URLs not present in data.db

- **Configuration & backups**
  - `config/settings.py` - separate paths for both databases
  - `src/database_backup.py` - `backup_all_databases()` backs up both
  - Databases stored in `databases/` directory

## Usage

```python
# Scraping (on scraping machine)
from src.scrape_jobs_list import scrape_jobs_list
scrape_jobs_list()  # → scrape.db

# Copy scrape.db to processing machine, then:
from src.structure_data_with_llm import structure_data_with_llm
structure_data_with_llm()  # reads scrape.db → writes data.db
```

See `DATABASE_SEPARATION.md` for deployment patterns and workflows.

## Summary
- Fix CBOR file reading loop exiting early when encountering records with empty data fields
- This was causing sleep analyzer to load only ~250 records instead of ~46,000 per night

## Root Cause
1. Some RAW files contain records with `data: b''` (empty byte string)
2. When `cbor2.loads(b'')` is called, it raises `CBORDecodeEOF`
3. `CBORDecodeEOF` inherits from `EOFError`
4. The `except EOFError: break` handler catches this, exiting the loop prematurely

## Fix
Skip records with empty data before attempting to decode.

body:
### Motivation
- Hazard geometry was effectively ignored because `hazardFromCell` used a hard threshold (`dangerThreshold` 0.7) so many UI danger values produced zero contribution.  
- The main `ctx:danger` axis did not include geometric hazard sources like `world:map:hazardProximity` / `haz:dangerSourceProximity`, so cell-based and between-agent hazards often did not affect appraisal/decisions.  
- Rumor/belief generation was non-deterministic because the seed was not stably derived from the active `SceneInstance`/snapshot.  
- Actions that target other agents were not penalized for dyad hazards (`hazardBetween`), so behavior didn’t reflect “between us danger”.

### Description
- Replace hard cutoff in `hazardFromCell` with a soft threshold scale and lower default `dangerThreshold` from `0.7` to `0.15` (file: `lib/context/stage1/hazardGeometry.ts`).  
- Expose hazard proximity sources into axis derivation by including `world:map:hazardProximity:<selfId>` and `haz:dangerSourceProximity:<selfId>` in `ctx:danger` inputs (file: `lib/context/axes/deriveAxes.ts`).  
- Make scene seeding deterministic: add `stableHashInt32`, add optional `seed` to `SceneInstance` type, compute a stable seed in `createSceneInstance`, and prefer `sceneInst.seed`/snapshot seeds for rumor generation (files: `lib/scene/types.ts`, `lib/scene/engine.ts`, `lib/goals/goalLabContext.ts`).  
- Penalize targetted actions by dyad hazards by reading `world:map:hazardBetween` / `soc:allyHazardBetween` / `soc:enemyHazardBetween` and adding pref/why parts in the scoring routine (file: `lib/decision/score.ts`).

body:
Adds undo/redo functionality to property editor widgets that automatically captures changes when widgets lose focus, similar to Blender's operator system.

## Core System (`movutl/core/undo.{hpp,cpp}`)

- **UndoCommand**: Base class implementing command pattern with `execute()`, `undo()`, and `description()`
- **EntityPropertyChangeCommand**: Records property changes via `getProps()`/`setProps()` API
- **UndoManager**: Singleton managing undo/redo stacks (max 100 commands, configurable)
- **add_command()**: Pushes already-executed commands to stack (for UI-triggered changes)

## UI Integration (`movutl/gui/widgets.cpp`)

Widget focus tracking automatically generates undo commands:
- Focus gain → capture initial value
- Focus loss → compare with current value → create command if changed

```cpp
// Static variables track editing state across frames
static Props::Value last_property_value;
static std::string last_property_name;

// On focus loss with value change:
auto cmd = std::make_unique<EntityPropertyChangeCommand>(
  entity, property_name, old_value, new_value
);
GetUndoManager().add_command(std::move(cmd));
```

## Menu & Shortcuts (`movutl/gui/{mainmenu,window}.cpp`)

- Edit menu: 元に戻す/やり直す/履歴をクリア
- Keyboard: Ctrl+Z (undo), Ctrl+Y/Ctrl+Shift+Z (redo)
- Tooltips show command descriptions

## API Usage

```cpp
#include <movutl/core/undo.hpp>

auto& mgr = GetUndoManager();
if(mgr.can_undo()) mgr.undo();
if(mgr.can_redo()) mgr.redo();
```

See `UNDO_REDO_IMPLEMENTATION.md` for implementation details and extending with custom commands.
